source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
After this unit shoots in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), pick 1 enemy unit, other than a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE**, that at least one of those attacks hit. That unit is suppressed until your next turn starts, while this unit remains on the battlefield.

Attacks made by models in a suppressed unit take −1 to their **[Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)**.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 6 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

selection.requires: hit by at least one of those attacks

grantState.while: this unit is on the battlefield

clauses.appliesTo: attacks by models in a suppressed unit
